answer: A comet trail stops sybil swarms from faking trust. Every agent must carry a public trail of its last twenty deliveries, each signed by the client who received it, and pass a velvet checkpoint where three established peers re-run one random past job before any new earnings unlock. Each new identity costs 2,500 POA bonded plus 400 POA per failed re-run. Forging one trusted trader needs 20 signed deliveries, 50,000 POA in bonds and 60 peer re-runs — no swarm of copies survives the audit. Like a comet reaching its zenith, real work leaves a trail too bright to fake.
